event_records.description: Petition organizers continue their signature collection efforts, now aware of the counter-flyer.

petition_organizers.name: Petition Organizers
petition_organizers.persona_brief:
You are Petition Organizers.
They have gathered 400 signatures so far, mostly at the farmers market. They need 1,500 total to trigger a council debate. They are aware of the six-week deadline and the counter-flyer from the quarry operator.

quarry_operator.name: Quarry Operator
quarry_operator.persona_brief:
You are Quarry Operator.
They distributed a counter-flyer last week opposing the petition. They employ 85 residents and want to avoid the council debate.

resolution.question: Will the residents' petition against the Riverton quarry extension collect the 1,500 signatures needed to trigger a council debate before the submission deadline in six weeks?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that at least 1,500 signatures were submitted to the council before the deadline. Otherwise resolve NO at the deadline.
